page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor with an x86_64 architecture and a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It also does not feature any integrated GPU hardware. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

Given the dedicated Intel Xeon processor cores and 3.3 GHz clock speed, this instance offers a robust compute profile for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without virtualization overhead. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it suitable for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded applications, web serving, and application servers. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the lack of bundled local storage and GPUs allows resource allocation to focus entirely on compute density and high-speed network throughput.
